title: Planning a dead-source item asks before the start whether the source rows that quote the dead source in their licence cells are reworded
goal: When a sprint plans an item that marks a source or repository dead, planning counts the _sources.csv rows whose licence or reuse cells quote it and asks a gate before the start gate on whether they are reworded in the item, so the choice is not a blocking gate mid-work (SP-df2cu4uj: BG-gxxv3mzj met it as gate g1, classed blocking by the word mirror, over 328 and 115 cells).
